filings.headline: Wins major EPC contract over ₹4,000cr for gas pipeline in UAE
filings.summary: Kalpataru Projects has secured an EPC contract for a gas pipeline project in the UAE. The order is classified as 'Major', meaning it is valued at over ₹4,000 crore, representing about 15% of the company's annual sales. This significant win strengthens the company's presence in the global oil and gas business.

filings.headline: Declared L-1 bidder for ₹688.23cr NHAI highway project in Maharashtra
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon has emerged as the lowest bidder for a ₹688.23 crore NHAI project to construct a 4-lane elevated corridor in Solapur City on a Hybrid Annuity Mode. The project has a 24-month execution period. This is a material win, equal to about 7.9% of the company's trailing 12-month sales.

filings.headline: Xponentia Group sold 6.4% stake (about ₹986cr) in the open market
filings.summary: Non-promoter Xponentia Group and its affiliates sold 28.34 lakh shares, representing a 6.42% stake in the company, through the open market. The sale is worth approximately ₹986 crore at the current share price and reduces their combined holding from 15.75% to 9.33%.

filings.headline: EGM to approve ₹272cr acquisition of Winwin via cash and 1.3% share swap
filings.summary: Quality Power Electrical is holding an EGM to approve the acquisition of up to 100% of Winwin Speciality Insulators for ₹272.34 crore. The deal will be funded by ₹123.84 crore in cash and a share swap issuing up to 10.17 lakh new shares at ₹1,460 each. The issue price is slightly below the current market price of ₹1,518 and will expand the share count by 1.31%, resulting in a 1.30% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: Adhish P. Patil appointed Managing Director as Prakash M. Patil steps down
filings.summary: Prakash M. Patil is stepping down as Managing Director ahead of his 2027 term expiry to facilitate a leadership transition. Current CFO Adhish P. Patil will take over as the new Managing Director effective October 1, 2026. Additionally, Uday M. Patil has retired as Whole-time Director and has been replaced by Nilesh B. Patil.

filings.headline: Subsidiary NML to raise ₹76.8cr via preferential issue to JV partner
filings.summary: Neogen Chemicals' step-down subsidiary, Neogen Morita New Materials (NML), will raise ₹76.8 crore by issuing 7.2 lakh shares to JV partner Morita Investment at ₹1,066.66 per share. Post-allotment, Morita will hold a 9.09% stake in NML. As this is a subsidiary issuance, it results in 0% dilution to Neogen Chemicals' existing 3.00 crore shares, and the issue price is not comparable to the parent's ₹2385 share price.

filings.headline: CRISIL revises outlook to 'Stable' on ₹2,030cr of debt and bank facilities
filings.summary: CRISIL has reaffirmed its long-term credit ratings for Neogen Chemicals at 'CRISIL A-' and for its subsidiary Neogen Ionics at 'CRISIL BBB+', while revising the outlook on both to 'Stable' from 'Negative'. The rated bank facilities and debt instruments amount to ₹2,030 crore. The outlook revision reflects an improved financial risk profile following the recent completion of a ₹600 crore QIP.

filings.headline: Shareholders reject Resolution 7 at Annual General Meeting
filings.summary: Acutaas Chemicals disclosed the voting results from its 19th Annual General Meeting. The company reported that shareholders rejected Resolution 7, while all other resolutions were approved. The filing text cuts off before detailing the subject of the failed resolution.

filings.headline: Completes 80% stake acquisition in Sunshine Healthcare, Ghana
filings.summary: Dr Lal PathLabs' wholly-owned subsidiary, DLPL Dubai, has completed the acquisition of an 80% stake in Sunshine Healthcare Limited, Ghana. As a result of the completed transaction, Sunshine Healthcare is now a step-down subsidiary of the company.

filings.headline: Outlines ₹4.5 billion capex for FY27-28 in Chairman's AGM address
filings.summary: In the Chairman's AGM address, the company highlighted a capital expenditure program of ₹2.5 billion for FY27 and ₹2.0 billion for FY28. This ₹4.5 billion planned investment exceeds the company's yearly sales of ₹3.56 billion and will be supported by its ₹4.69 billion in investible capital. The company also noted the commissioning of its 220 TPD Uluberia 2 facility during FY26.

filings.headline: USFDA inspection at New Jersey office concludes with zero observations
filings.summary: The USFDA conducted an onsite inspection of Zydus' pharmacovigilance and post-marketing surveillance system at its New Jersey office from September 22 to 25, 2026. The inspection concluded successfully with nil observations. This clean regulatory outcome is a positive for the company's US operations.

filings.headline: KPMG resigns as statutory auditor of UK material subsidiaries over fees
filings.summary: KPMG LLP has resigned as the statutory auditor for four UK-based material subsidiaries of Tata Chemicals, as continuing its previous audit fees was no longer acceptable to the entities. KNAV Limited has been appointed as the new auditor for these subsidiaries, which include British Salt Limited (accounting for 5% of consolidated revenue). The parent company's auditor, BSR & Co. LLP, remains unchanged.

filings.headline: Karaikal EDC plant restarts operations after July shutdown; ₹5cr damage estimated
filings.summary: Chemplast Sanmar has restarted operations at its EDC plant in Karaikal following provisional clearance from local factory and pollution authorities. The plant had been shut down following an incident in mid-July 2026. The company estimates plant and machinery damage at ₹5 crores and has initiated an insurance claim.

filings.headline: Allots 11.97 lakh shares via QIP at ₹2088 each to raise ₹250cr
filings.summary: Wheels India has approved the allotment of 11.97 lakh equity shares to qualified institutional buyers at ₹2088 per share, raising ₹250 crore. This adds 4.67% more shares, diluting existing investors by 4.46%. The issue price represents a roughly 9% discount to the current share price of ₹2296.

filings.headline: Announces ₹31.7cr solar investment and plans to enter data centre sector
filings.summary: During its AGM, management announced a ₹31.7 crore investment in an 8.79 MW captive solar plant, which is expected to generate annual savings of about ₹8.7 crore. The company also outlined plans to marginally expand capacity and enter new sectors such as data centres by FY28.

filings.headline: Promoter trust to put in ₹650cr through warrants (about 4% dilution)
filings.summary: The board approved 2.81 crore warrants at ₹231.55 each (the SEBI floor price) for the promoter family's trust, with half the money due upfront. If all are converted they add about 4.2% to the roughly 67 crore shares in issue, diluting other holders by about 4%, and the promoter group's stake rises from 59.1% to 60.7%. It shores up a balance sheet that CARE rates BBB−, but the price is the regulatory floor, about 6% below the recent share price, and shareholders still have to approve it.

filings.headline: Aditya Infotech allots 43.26 lakh shares via QIP to raise ₹1,500 crore
filings.summary: Aditya Infotech has allotted 43.26 lakh equity shares to institutional buyers through a QIP, raising approximately ₹1,500 crore. The issue price of ₹3,467 per share is at a roughly 6% discount to the current market price of ₹3,688. The allotment increases the total share count by 3.66%, resulting in a 3.53% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: DGTR recommends 5-year anti-dumping duty on Chinese glassware imports
filings.summary: The Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR) has recommended imposing an anti-dumping duty on Borosilicate Table and Kitchen Glassware from China for five years. The investigation was initiated by Borosil, which is the sole domestic producer of these goods in India. This is a positive development expected to significantly improve the company's competitive position against dumped imports.

filings.headline: Acquires Mahim development rights for ₹82.72cr; estimated GDV of ₹800cr
filings.summary: Suraj Estate's subsidiary has completed the acquisition of development rights for a 2,941 sq meter plot in Mahim (West), Mumbai, for an investment of ₹82.72 crore. The plot will be amalgamated with an existing commercial project to generate around 1.50 lakh sq ft of saleable area with an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹800 crore. This is a significant addition, with the expected GDV exceeding the company's trailing 12-month sales of ₹569 crore.

filings.headline: Limited commercial production begins at new Pune manufacturing facility
filings.summary: Sedemac Mechatronics has commenced limited commercial production at its new Manufacturing Facility-3 in Pune, Maharashtra, effective September 25, 2026. The company will progressively operationalize the remaining manufacturing processes at the plant. This marks a positive step in the company's capacity expansion plans.

filings.headline: Executes agreement to acquire U M Cables' business undertaking
filings.summary: RR Kabel has executed a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the business undertaking of U M Cables Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Usha Martin Limited. The transaction is structured as a slump sale on a going concern basis. Financial details were disclosed in an earlier intimation and are not included in this filing.

filings.headline: Promoter group buys 1.52 lakh shares for ₹6.69 crore in the open market
filings.summary: Nirani Holdings Private Limited, part of the promoter group, purchased 1,52,201 equity shares from the open market for ₹6.69 crore. The shares were bought at an average price of ₹439.32 each, raising the entity's stake from 1.93% to 2.11%. Open-market purchases by promoters are often seen as a sign of confidence in the company's prospects.

filings.headline: Secures 194-acre land parcel in Gurugram with ₹5,500-6,000cr GDV potential
filings.summary: Signatureglobal has acquired 25 acres and signed collaboration agreements for 169.22 acres in Farrukhnagar, Gurugram for a luxury villa project. The transaction adds 6.77 million sq. ft. of developable area to its pipeline with an estimated Gross Development Value of ₹5,500-6,000 crore, a massive addition compared to its ₹2,281 crore trailing annual sales.

filings.headline: Commissions 325 TPD Air Separation Unit under 15-year take-or-pay contract
filings.summary: Ellenbarrie has successfully commissioned a 325 Tons per day (TPD) Air Separation Unit at Jai Balaji Industries' Durgapur facility. Revenues from this 15-year take-or-pay gas supply agreement commence immediately, providing long-term visibility for a company with annual sales of ₹356 crore.

filings.headline: Subsidiary Linjemontage lists in Sweden, yielding SEK 711.5M for KPIL
filings.summary: KPIL's step-down subsidiary Linjemontage has successfully listed on Nasdaq Stockholm at a total valuation of SEK 2,357 million. KPIL retains a 65.9% stake and will receive a gross consideration of approximately SEK 711.5 million. The move unlocks significant value for shareholders and generates substantial cash for the company.

filings.headline: Partners with ITC Hotels for luxury property; projects ₹150-200cr annual revenue
filings.summary: Arihant's subsidiary has signed an agreement with ITC Hotels to develop a 227-room luxury property under the 'Mementos' brand. Slated for completion in three years, the hotel is projected to generate ₹150-200 crores in annual revenue with a 45% operating margin. This marks a major strategic expansion into hospitality, representing a substantial new annuity income stream compared to the company's ₹561 crore yearly sales.

filings.headline: Promoter bought 1.8% (₹200cr) at about ₹588
filings.summary: Promoter and Director Mr. Chaitanya Jalan bought 1.8% of the company (34,00,000 shares worth ₹200cr) through a preferential offer at an average price of ₹588, well below the current price of ₹705. This purchase increased his total holding from 1.6% to 3.5%.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.18% (₹6.7cr) at about ₹439
filings.summary: Promoter group entity Nirani Holdings Private Limited bought 1,52,201 shares (0.18% of the company) for ₹6.7 crore at an average price of ₹439, which is below today's price of ₹451. This market purchase increased their total holding from 1.9% to 2.1%.

filings.headline: Promoter group sold 2.8% (₹209cr) at about ₹819
filings.summary: Promoters and promoter group entities sold 2.8% of the company for ₹209cr via a market sale. They sold at an average price of ₹819—compared to the current price of ₹934—reducing their combined holding from 3.4% to 1.5%.

filings.headline: Promoter sold 0.27% (₹14.0cr) at about ₹528
filings.summary: Promoter Harshbeena Zaveri sold 0.27% of the company (2,66,080 shares) in the open market for ₹14.0cr. The shares were sold at an average price of ₹528—below the current market price of ₹549—reducing her total holding from 41.5% to 41.2%.

filings.headline: Raised ₹200cr of unrated private debentures
filings.summary: It allotted 20,000 secured, unrated and unlisted debentures of ₹1 lakh each, ₹200cr in all, on a private placement. On the same day it approved a ₹20cr corporate guarantee for its subsidiary Cloud Wave, replacing the personal guarantees of the sellers. New borrowing while most of the Akkodis sale money is still deferred adds to the balance-sheet risk flagged in the note.

filings.headline: Completes acquisition of 100% stake in Actis Generics
filings.summary: RPG Life Sciences' subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited (RPGAP), has completed the acquisition of the entire stake in Actis Generics Private Limited. Following the closure of the July 2026 share purchase agreement, Actis is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of RPGAP.

filings.headline: Subsidiary acquires land in Mumbai for ₹120cr to develop 172-key hotel
filings.summary: Lemon Tree's material subsidiary, Fleur Hotels, has completed the acquisition of a 989 sq. metre land parcel in Bandra (East), Mumbai, for ₹120 crore. The site will be used to develop a 172-key upscale Lemon Tree Premier hotel adjoining the Bandra Kurla Complex. The acquisition cost represents roughly 8% of the company's annual sales.

filings.headline: Allotted 40 acres of land in West Bengal for a new manufacturing facility
filings.summary: The company has received an in-principle approval from WBIDC for the allotment of approximately 40 acres of land at Vidyasagar Industrial Park, Kharagpur. The land, allotted on a 99-year lease, will be used to set up a new manufacturing facility for integrated power cables and conductors to expand capacity and support future growth.

filings.headline: Targets ₹10,000cr pre-sales and ₹15,000cr project launches in FY27
filings.summary: At its AGM, the company provided strong FY27 guidance, targeting project launches worth ₹15,000 crore and pre-sales of nearly ₹10,000 crore. It also aims for ₹5,000 crore in collections, indicating massive scale compared to its last 12 months' reported sales of ₹2,281 crore. Shareholders also approved the appointment of S.N. Dhawan & Co LLP as statutory auditors.

filings.headline: AGM held to ratify waiver of excessive managerial remuneration
filings.summary: Tarsons Products held its AGM to transact business including the approval of material related-party transactions with its step-down subsidiary, Nerbe Plus GmbH & Co. KG. Notably, shareholders were also asked to approve and ratify the waiver of excessive managerial remuneration paid to executive and non-executive directors.

filings.headline: Shareholders approve related-party land acquisition and preferential share issue
filings.summary: Shareholders approved a material related-party transaction to acquire securities in land-owning companies. They also approved a preferential issue of equity shares via a share swap. The exact number of shares, issue price, and resulting dilution are not provided in this voting-results filing.

filings.headline: Preferential issue of up to 50 lakh equity shares at ₹135 to raise ₹67.5 crore
filings.summary: Manba Finance will hold an EGM to approve a preferential issue of up to 50 lakh equity shares at ₹135 each to raise ₹67.5 crore, alongside an issuance of fully convertible warrants. The equity issue alone increases the share count by 9.9% (a 9% dilution for current holders) and is priced slightly below the current market price of ₹139.

filings.headline: Incorporates WOS with ₹10 crore capital for EV battery films business
filings.summary: TCPL Packaging has incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, TCPL Energy Materials Limited, with an authorized share capital of ₹10 crore. The new entity will manufacture lithium-ion battery separator films for electric vehicles and energy storage. This marks a significant strategic diversification outside its traditional packaging business.

filings.headline: Promoter entity pledges 1.63% stake (14 lakh shares) to secure debt
filings.summary: Promoter group entity Nirani Holdings has pledged 14 lakh shares, representing 1.63% of the company's equity, to Jio Credit. The ₹58.1 crore pledge secures debt taken by the promoters to finance further share acquisitions in the company.

filings.headline: Commissions Phase II of Tarapur Greenfield facility with ₹222cr investment
filings.summary: NGL Fine-Chem has commenced commercial production at Phase II of its Greenfield API facility in Tarapur, marking the full commissioning of the plant. The total investment for the expansion is ₹222 crore, financed via ₹84 crore in term loans and ₹138 crore from internal accruals. This represents a substantial capital expenditure equivalent to roughly 42% of the company's trailing 12-month sales of ₹525 crore, which will augment flexible manufacturing capacity for its diverse product portfolio.

filings.headline: Starts Phase 1 of new heavy structural steel plant in AP with 24,000 MT/pa capacity
filings.summary: Interarch has inaugurated Phase 1 of its heavy structural steel manufacturing facility in Attivaram, Andhra Pradesh, featuring an initial capacity of 24,000 MT per annum. The new plant expands the company's portfolio beyond conventional PEB applications into complex, high-performance structural steel for high-growth sectors. Civil works for Phase 2 at the site are currently underway.

filings.headline: Shareholders approve alteration of MOA object clause
filings.summary: At the 10th Annual General Meeting, shareholders passed all resolutions with the requisite majority. Notably, this included a special resolution to alter the object clause of the company's Memorandum of Association, which clears the way for potential changes or expansions to its permitted business activities.

filings.headline: Pine Labs partners with Google Cloud for AI-driven agentic commerce
filings.summary: Pine Labs has announced a strategic collaboration with Google Cloud to develop next-generation agentic commerce products for Indian merchants. The partnership will leverage Google's Gemini AI to create a unified ecosystem bridging merchant operations, customer engagement, and payment infrastructure.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgrades outlook to Stable and reaffirms ratings on ₹604cr bank facilities
filings.summary: CRISIL has reaffirmed the company's long-term and short-term ratings at A- and A2+, while upgrading the outlook from 'Negative' to 'Stable'. The total rated bank loan facilities were also enhanced from ₹457 crore to ₹604 crore.

filings.headline: Upcoming project GDV hits ₹18,000cr; FY26 pre-sales reach ₹901cr
filings.summary: Arkade Developers provided a business update marking two years since its IPO. The company's upcoming project gross development value (GDV) has surged 500% to ₹18,000 crore. Additionally, FY26 pre-sales reached ₹901 crore and recent land acquisitions in Goregaon and Thane totalled approximately ₹530 crore.

filings.headline: Completion certificate received for ₹1393cr highway project in Delhi
filings.summary: H.G. Infra Engineering has received the completion certificate from NHAI for a ₹1393.11 crore highway project in Delhi. The 6-lane Urban Extension Road package has been declared fit for commercial operation. This completed project represents nearly 29% of the company's annual sales, marking a significant execution milestone.

filings.headline: Crisil assigns upgraded AA- and A1+ ratings for ₹636cr bank facilities
filings.summary: Crisil has assigned long-term and short-term credit ratings of AA- (Stable) and A1+ for the company's ₹636 crore bank facilities. This represents an upgrade from the previous ratings of ICRA A+ and ICRA A1, reflecting an improved credit profile.

filings.headline: Promoter exploring sale of its stake in a potential control transaction
filings.summary: Whirlpool India clarified news reports regarding its promoter selling its entire stake, which had caused shares to surge 17%. The company confirmed receiving communication that promoter Whirlpool Mauritius intends to sell its shares in a control transaction and is currently exploring this with multiple potential counterparties. Whirlpool India noted it is not a party to these negotiations.

filings.headline: Secures new orders worth ₹2,025 crore across business segments
filings.summary: Kalpataru Projects has secured new orders worth ₹2,025 crore across its power transmission, buildings, and oil and gas businesses. The contract wins equate to about 7.4% of trailing 12-month sales, bringing the company's year-to-date order intake to ₹13,219 crore.

filings.headline: Landmark Cars partners with OLX India for pre-owned car platform
filings.summary: Landmark Cars has entered a strategic partnership with OLX India to create an integrated pre-owned car platform. Under the revenue-sharing agreement, OLX will manage the online customer journey while Landmark's 140+ retail outlets will serve as physical experience centres for vehicle inspections and handovers. This alliance enables the company to significantly scale its used-car operations by tapping into OLX's 23 million annual users.

filings.headline: OLX India partners with Landmark Cars for phygital used-car platform
filings.summary: CarTrade Tech's platform OLX India has formed a strategic partnership with premium auto retailer Landmark Cars to build a physical-digital pre-owned car platform. The tie-up integrates Landmark's network of over 140 physical touchpoints with OLX's digital reach of 23 million annual users. Vehicles will be acquired and sold on a revenue-sharing basis, initially launching in select cities before a pan-India rollout.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.40% (₹75.0cr) at about ₹600
filings.summary: Promoters and Directors Nikhil Kumar and Mohib Nomanbhai Khericha bought 0.40% of the company (12,50,000 shares) via allotment for ₹75.0cr. They paid an average price of ₹600 per share, which is below the current price of ₹719, increasing their holding from 8.3% to 8.7%.

filings.headline: Kotak Mahindra AMC crosses 5% shareholding threshold
filings.summary: Kotak Mahindra Asset Management Company has submitted a disclosure under SEBI SAST Regulation 29(1). This indicates that the asset manager has acquired a stake crossing the 5% threshold, making it a new large institutional shareholder in the company.

filings.headline: Promoter pledged 5.90% of shares
filings.summary: Promoter Lunolux Limited has created an additional pledge over 1.14 crore shares, representing 5.90% of the company's total paid-up share capital. The shares were pledged to Catalyst Trusteeship Limited acting as a security agent for lenders under an existing facility agreement.

filings.headline: ₹177cr satellite-communication order from Zetwerk
filings.summary: A firm purchase order worth ₹177.35cr including taxes, under the rate contract Zetwerk awarded in March, to be delivered by March 2027. That is about 70% of Avantel’s last 12 months of sales, so it adds strongly to FY27 revenue visibility.

filings.headline: Won a tender to assemble fighter-aircraft wings and centre fuselage
filings.summary: Its subsidiary JK Maini Global Aerospace won a tender from a leading Indian aerospace OEM to assemble wing and centre-fuselage structures for a major indigenous fighter programme. It is Raymond’s entry into aircraft structures; no contract value was given, and management calls it strategically larger than its immediate revenue.

filings.headline: Cleared to buy Premier Explosives; funding issue means about 18% dilution
filings.summary: The CCI said the Premier Explosives deal is too small to need its approval, so the open offer can go ahead. A day earlier Apollo revised its EGM papers for issuing 2.28 crore shares and 5.69 crore warrants to fund it, after questions from NSE. Together that is about 8 crore new shares, some 21% more than the roughly 37 crore in issue, so existing holders would be diluted by about 18% once the warrants convert. The deal is large and dilutive; the note’s avoid view rests on its governance and cash.

filings.headline: Shareholders approved higher pay for the four family directors
filings.summary: The AGM approved revised pay, including a profit-linked element, for the managing director and three whole-time directors, all from the founding family. The note already flags family pay at about 30% of profit; this adds to it.

filings.headline: Pledges shares and gives corporate guarantee for ₹300cr subsidiary debt
filings.summary: Anupam Rasayan has pledged its 100% stake in subsidiary Mates Visa Consultancy and a 15% stake in Purebliss Pharma Solutions to secure up to ₹300 crore in non-convertible debentures issued by the subsidiary. The company has also provided an unconditional corporate guarantee for the debt, the proceeds of which will be used to acquire securities of Bliss GVS Pharma.

filings.headline: Commercial production from third double-wall line delayed to Jan 2027
filings.summary: Borosil announced a delay in commencing commercial production from the third double-wall line at its wholly owned subsidiary, Stylenest India Limited. Originally expected in Q2 FY27, production is now slated for January 2027. The delay is attributed to supply-chain constraints for equipment imported from China and scheduling issues with the supplier's technical personnel.

filings.headline: GST search and seizure proceedings initiated at company premises
filings.summary: The Maharashtra GST department initiated search and seizure proceedings at the registered office and manufacturing units of the company and its subsidiary, Clean Fino Chem, on September 23, 2026. While the company states there is currently no material impact on operations or financials, the action poses a potential risk of future tax demands or penalties.

filings.headline: Promoters abstain from voting on resolutions; company seeks legal opinion
filings.summary: Hexagon Nutrition disclosed that its promoter shareholders abstained from voting on certain undisclosed resolutions. The company is now seeking an independent legal opinion to determine the appropriate course of action. This unusual governance development warrants monitoring by investors.

filings.headline: Seeking Board approval for rights issue of equity shares
filings.summary: Ola Electric is seeking Board approval for a proposed rights issue of equity shares to allow participation by all eligible shareholders. The exact issue size, price, and dilution details have not been disclosed in this filing.

filings.headline: Shareholders approve appointment of Shashvat Somany as Joint MD
filings.summary: Shareholders at the AGM have approved the appointment of Mr. Shashvat Somany as Director and Joint Managing Director of the company. The appointment is effective from October 1, 2026.

filings.headline: Signs MoU for Ghaziabad joint development project with ₹2,500-3,000cr GDV potential
filings.summary: Max Estates has signed a binding Memorandum of Understanding for a Joint Development Agreement for a 9.76-acre land parcel in Ghaziabad. The capital-light, revenue-sharing project offers 1.5 million sq. ft. of development potential and an estimated Gross Development Value of ₹2,500-3,000 crore. This marks the company's entry into Ghaziabad and is highly material compared to its ₹200 crore trailing twelve-month sales.

filings.headline: Rashesh Gogri appointed MD; Hetal Gogri Gala transitions to WTD
filings.summary: Smt. Hetal Gogri Gala will transition from Managing Director to Whole-time Director effective October 1, 2026. Concurrently, Shri Rashesh C. Gogri will assume the role of Managing Director. Additionally, Shri Rajendra Gogri has stepped down as a Non-Executive Director following the recent AGM.

filings.headline: Sudarshan Patodia appointed as Group Chief Financial Officer
filings.summary: Rainbow Children's Medicare has appointed Mr. Sudarshan Patodia as Chief Financial Officer and Group CFO, effective September 23, 2026. He is a Chartered Accountant with nearly two decades of experience, having previously served as CFO at Centre for Sight.

filings.headline: Merger of Pitti Industries and Dakshin Foundry into company becomes effective
filings.summary: Pitti Engineering announced that the scheme of amalgamation of Pitti Industries Private Limited and Dakshin Foundry Private Limited into the company became effective on September 23, 2026. The appointed date for the merger is April 1, 2026. Consequently, the authorized share capital of the company has been combined and increased to ₹196.89 crore.

filings.headline: CCO and Cogentiq CEO Matthew Gennone resigns effective October 2
filings.summary: Mr. Matthew Gennone has resigned as Chief Commercial Officer and CEO of Cogentiq to pursue a CEO opportunity at another organization. He will step down at the close of business on October 2, 2026. The Cogentiq team will report to Srikanth Velamakanni on an interim basis while commercial responsibilities are distributed across business units.

filings.headline: Board approves 1:1 bonus share issue
filings.summary: The board has approved a 1:1 bonus issue, granting one free equity share for every share held. This creates 100% more shares, increasing the total from 10.46 crore to 20.92 crore, but results in 0% dilution to existing holders. The shares are issued at nil cost by capitalizing ₹10.46 crore from the share premium account.

filings.headline: Declared preferred bidder for limestone mine block with 5.67 lakh MT reserve in Gujarat
filings.summary: GHCL has been declared the preferred bidder in an e-auction for a composite license for the Kadaya limestone block in Gujarat. The mining block spans 6.8797 hectares and holds an estimated 5,67,337 metric tonnes of limestone reserves. The company must submit a performance security within 45 days to receive the formal Letter of Intent, securing a vital raw material source for its chemical operations.

filings.headline: Valuation sets preferential warrant issue price at ₹422.93
filings.summary: Kiri Industries issued a corrigendum to its AGM notice regarding a proposed preferential issue of convertible warrants. A newly required valuation report has priced the warrants at ₹422.93 each, which is a discount to the current market price of ₹558. The filing notes the issue will account for over 5% of the post-issue fully diluted share capital, though exact warrant numbers were not disclosed in this document.

filings.headline: Subsidiary commissions Phase-I of 6 GWh lithium-ion cell facility in Bengaluru
filings.summary: Exide's material subsidiary, Exide Energy Solutions Limited, successfully commissioned Phase-I of its lithium-ion cell manufacturing facility on September 23, 2026. The Bengaluru-based plant has a capacity of 6 GWh and will produce advanced lithium-ion cells across multiple chemistries for mobility and energy storage applications.

filings.headline: Corrigendum details preferential issue of 15 lakh shares and 15 lakh warrants
filings.summary: Kross has issued a corrigendum to its postal ballot regarding a preferential allotment of 15 lakh equity shares and 15 lakh convertible warrants to promoters and non-promoters. Assuming full conversion, the 30 lakh new shares will expand the outstanding share base by 4.65%, diluting existing shareholders by 4.4%.

filings.headline: Canadian tribunal rules in favour of subsidiary, imposing duties on Chinese imports
filings.summary: The Canadian International Trade Tribunal has ruled that dumped and subsidized Chinese forged grinding media threaten the domestic industry. Anti-dumping and countervailing duties will now be collected by Canadian authorities, which Tega expects to positively impact the business prospects of its indirect subsidiary, Moly-Cop Canada.

filings.headline: Shareholders approve fund-raise via preferential issue
filings.summary: Shareholders have approved a special resolution to raise funds through a preferential issue on a private placement basis. The filing does not disclose the amount to be raised, the issue price, or the number of shares to be issued to calculate dilution.

filings.headline: Cargills Bank expands partnership, upgrades to Intellect's eMACH.ai platform
filings.summary: Intellect Design Arena has expanded its strategic partnership with Sri Lanka's Cargills Bank. The bank has chosen to upgrade to Intellect's Composable eMACH.ai platform across core banking, lending, trade finance, and treasury. The financial value of the contract was not disclosed.

filings.headline: ICRA revises credit rating outlook to Negative on rising receivables
filings.summary: ICRA has reaffirmed Oswal Pumps' long-term credit rating at ICRA A+ but revised its outlook from stable to negative. The agency cited a substantial build-up in receivables and moderating profitability due to rising input costs and increased competition. The rating outlook for its material subsidiary, Oswal Solar Energy, was similarly revised to negative.

filings.headline: Court allows release of seized API for ₹72L deposit; criminal proceedings continue
filings.summary: The Bombay High Court has allowed the provisional release of a 200 kg consignment of Ketamine Hydrochloride, subject to a ₹72 lakh deposit. However, the court clarified that authorities may continue adjudication and criminal proceedings under the NDPS Act, highlighting ongoing regulatory risks.

filings.headline: Order wins worth ₹797 crore for domestic and international T&D projects
filings.summary: Skipper Limited has secured new orders aggregating to ₹797 crore for domestic and international Power T&D projects, including export orders to Australia. This substantial win represents about 14% of the company's trailing 12-month sales and strengthens its high-voltage transmission infrastructure portfolio.

filings.headline: Signs MoU with Lubrizol for TPU films; announces ₹118cr capex
filings.summary: Garware Hi-Tech Films has signed an MoU with Lubrizol to develop and manufacture TPU-based film solutions in India. The company will invest ₹118 crore (about 5.2% of yearly sales) in advanced TPU film extrusion capabilities, expected to be operational by December 2026. The backward integration will expand PPF capacity and is projected to improve consolidated EBITDA margins by 150-200 basis points.

filings.headline: Wins ₹297.5cr order for 46.7 MW rooftop solar project in Telangana
filings.summary: Oswal Pumps has secured a ₹297.5 crore (including GST) order from TGREDCO to install 46.7 MW of rooftop solar capacity across 9,937 government schools in Telangana. The project must be completed within 180 days and represents about 14% of trailing 12-month sales, marking the company's entry into the state.

filings.headline: Set up Akkodis AXISCADES Aerospace Engineering
filings.summary: It incorporated a new Indian subsidiary for the aerospace engineering venture with Akkodis announced in June. This is a step in the Akkodis deal; the note already treats most of that deal’s value as deferred.

filings.headline: Seeks approval to enter medical devices and energy storage
filings.summary: A postal ballot asks shareholders to widen the company’s objects to medical devices, healthcare, energy storage and testing services, ahead of the proposed merger of Imeds into Avantel. A move away from its defence-communications core deserves watching.

filings.headline: EGM on 15 Oct for a ₹300cr share issue (about 6.4% dilution)
filings.summary: Shareholders will vote on 15 October on issuing 25.73 lakh new shares at ₹1,166 each, about ₹300cr, on a preferential basis. That adds about 6.8% to the roughly 3.79 crore shares in issue, so existing holders are diluted by about 6.4%, and the price is about 17% below the recent share price of about ₹1,400.

filings.headline: Shareholders reject special resolution to increase ESOP pool
filings.summary: A special resolution to increase the employee stock option grant pool by 100,000 options to 1.5 million was defeated in a postal ballot. The proposal received 70.35% votes in favour, falling short of the 75% majority required to pass.

filings.headline: EGM called to approve preferential issue of equity shares and warrants
filings.summary: Yatharth Hospital has called an EGM on October 15, 2026, to approve a preferential issue of equity shares and warrants to an investor. To accommodate the allotment, the authorized share capital will be increased by 3.5 crore shares, which represents a maximum of 36.3% more shares and up to 26.7% potential dilution to existing holders. The exact issue size and pricing are not detailed in the provided excerpt.

filings.headline: Purchases previously leased land in Tamil Nadu, ending DBS Bank arrangement
filings.summary: Orchid Pharma has purchased previously leased land in Patibulum Village, Tamil Nadu. The acquisition concludes the erstwhile lease arrangement and ends DBS Bank's rights to the property, resolving a prior dispute. The transaction provides the company with full ownership clarity, though the purchase value was not disclosed.

filings.headline: Records ₹500+ crore bookings in 30 days at new Bengaluru project
filings.summary: Arvind SmartSpaces announced bookings of over ₹500 crore at its new premium residential project, Arvind Sylva, in Bengaluru within 30 days of launch. This represents about 60% of the project's ₹860 crore revenue potential, a highly significant figure compared to the company's trailing annual sales of ₹780 crore.

filings.headline: Targets 15-18% revenue and EBITDA CAGR over 3-4 years
filings.summary: The company outlined its growth outlook at the AGM, targeting a 15-18% CAGR for revenue and EBITDA over the next 3-4 years. It also guided for FY27 capex of around ₹400 crore and announced upcoming capex for Atali Block 2 for specific CDMO/CMO projects.

filings.headline: Chief Revenue & Growth Officer Saket Bhatnagar resigns
filings.summary: Saket Bhatnagar has resigned as Chief Revenue & Growth Officer, effective September 21, 2026, to pursue opportunities outside the organization. Investors should monitor the departure of a key executive responsible for revenue growth.

filings.headline: Completes exit from joint venture Crystal HR via stake sale and buyback
filings.summary: TeamLease Services has completed the divestment of its entire 30% stake (3,000 equity shares) in joint venture Crystal HR and Security Solutions. The exit was executed by transferring 1,800 shares to a JV promoter and tendering the remaining 1,200 shares for a buyback by the JV.

filings.headline: Shareholders approve multiple related-party deals and subsidiary pledges
filings.summary: Shareholders have approved 18 material related-party transactions among various step-down subsidiaries through a postal ballot. They also approved the creation of pledges or security interests over the shares and assets of the company's material subsidiaries.

filings.headline: Targets ₹4,500cr revenue by FY28; announces ₹4,000cr capex plan
filings.summary: Solex Energy outlined a major growth strategy at its AGM, targeting ₹4,500 crore in revenue by FY28. The company plans to invest ₹4,000 crore by FY30 to build up to 5.2 GW of solar cell and 10 GWh of battery storage capacities. It also highlighted current order visibility exceeding ₹3,400 crore, which is more than double its recent annual sales.

filings.headline: Scraps ₹42cr direct capex plan, shifts Bharuch facility to BSL
filings.summary: Borosil has cancelled its plan to directly invest ₹42 crore in a new glassware manufacturing facility at Bharuch, Gujarat. Instead, the facility will be funded and set up by Borosil Scientific Limited (BSL). Borosil will now meet its long-term product needs through its existing manufacturing arrangement with BSL.

filings.headline: Upward revision of South Central Railway order to ₹154.65cr
filings.summary: RITES has announced an upward revision for an ongoing railway electrification project with South Central Railway, originally awarded in 2020. The total project cost has increased from ₹97.96 crore to ₹154.65 crore. The revised total order value represents approximately 6.3% of the company's trailing 12-month sales.

filings.headline: Commissions additional 5 MW solar power capacity in Maharashtra
filings.summary: Ceigall Green Energy MH2 Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary, has successfully commissioned an additional 5 MW solar power plant in Maharashtra. This brings its operational capacity to 10 MW out of a total planned 147 MW project. The commissioning was achieved ahead of schedule, making the project eligible for early-commissioning incentives, with power being sold to MSEDCL.

filings.headline: 600 TPD capacity expansion delayed to Mar 2027; cost rises by ₹150cr to ₹1100cr
filings.summary: Borosil Renewables has delayed the commissioning of its 600 TPD capacity expansion at Bharuch from December 2026 to March 2027 due to supply chain disruptions. The project's estimated cost has also increased by ₹150 crores to ₹1,100 crores, which will be funded through internal accruals. Once completed, total installed capacity will rise from 1,000 TPD to 1,600 TPD.

filings.headline: Subsidiary inaugurates 120,000 sq ft MedTech manufacturing facility in Jodhpur
filings.summary: Syrma Johari MedTech, a subsidiary of the company, has inaugurated a new Medical Plastics and Precision Molding Facility in Jodhpur. The new 120,000+ sq. ft. plant will manufacture precision medical components, expanding the group's global MedTech manufacturing capabilities.

filings.headline: Starts production at new laminate plant adding 60,000 tonnes annual capacity
filings.summary: Stylam Industries has commenced commercial production at its new laminate plant in Manak Tabra, Haryana. The ₹300 crore facility adds 5.25 crore square meters (60,000 tonnes) of annual capacity, significantly expanding its existing capacity of 8.60 crore square meters. The expansion was financed entirely through internal accruals.

filings.headline: Enters Delhi-NCR market, securing 13.44-acre land with ₹5,200cr GDV potential
filings.summary: Puravankara has entered the Delhi-NCR real estate market by securing a 13.44-acre land parcel in Greater Noida. The site offers a saleable potential of 4.57 million sq ft and an estimated gross development value (GDV) of ₹5,200 crore. This major expansion is highly material, as the project's potential GDV exceeds the company's trailing 12-month sales of ₹4,064 crore.

filings.headline: Receives regulatory approvals to enter Azerbaijan oncology market
filings.summary: Beta Drugs has received regulatory approvals for its oncology portfolio in Azerbaijan across multiple dosage forms. The company has already filed 15 product dossiers and expects to file another 15 within a month. This expansion aims to build its international presence, with commercialization expected during the current financial year.

filings.headline: Secures solar and energy storage EPC orders totaling approximately ₹985 crore
filings.summary: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy has won two orders totaling approximately ₹985 crore, which is equivalent to about 13% of its annual sales. The awards include a 534.3 MWp solar project in Rajasthan for a new client and a 616 MWh turnkey energy storage project in South Africa.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgrades long-term credit rating to AA/Stable
filings.summary: CRISIL has upgraded Welspun Enterprises' long-term credit rating to AA/Stable from AA-/Positive for its Rs. 2,600 crore bank loan facilities. Ratings for material subsidiaries Welspun Michigan Engineers and Welspun EDAC JV were also upgraded. This reflects an improvement in the company's credit profile and could lead to lower borrowing costs.

filings.headline: Founder Patanjali Keswani to transition to Non-Executive Chairman in 2027
filings.summary: Shareholders have approved the appointment of founder Patanjali Govind Keswani as Chairman and Non-Executive Director, effective April 1, 2027. He will step down from his executive responsibilities at the end of his current 18-month tenure as Executive Chairman to ensure leadership continuity.

filings.headline: Crop Care Business CEO Rajavelu N.K. resigns; Sivaram Yadavalli named interim CEO
filings.summary: Mr. Rajavelu N.K. has resigned as the Chief Executive Officer of the Crop Care Business to pursue an external opportunity, effective November 24, 2026. Mr. Sivaram Yadavalli, currently Head of Strategy & Business Development, will take on the additional role of interim CEO for the segment starting November 25, 2026.

filings.headline: Allots 12.32 lakh shares at ₹1,461 each to raise ₹180cr via preferential issue
filings.summary: Wheels India has allotted 12.32 lakh equity shares on a preferential basis to investors including TSF Investments and promoter group members, raising ₹180 crore. The issue price of ₹1,461 is at a significant discount to the current market price of ₹2,296. The allotment adds 5.0% more shares to the pre-issue base of 2.44 crore, resulting in a 4.8% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: Promoters transition to non-executive roles; Suyog Kotecha named MD & CEO
filings.summary: Promoters Rajendra V. Gogri, Rashesh C. Gogri, and Renil R. Gogri will transition to non-executive board roles from October 1, 2026. Suyog Kotecha will assume the role of Managing Director and CEO for a five-year term, marking a shift to professional executive leadership.

filings.headline: Jayesh Doshi appointed Whole-time Director until 2031
filings.summary: Syrma SGS Technology has appointed Jayesh Nagindas Doshi as a Whole-time Director for a term ending March 2031. He previously served as a Non-Executive Director and brings 37 years of experience in corporate finance and strategy. This filing is a clarification of an earlier intimation regarding the appointment.

filings.headline: Proxy firm IiAS opposes promoter pay and related-party deals
filings.summary: Proxy advisory firm IiAS has recommended shareholders vote against the reappointment of the MD, promoter remuneration, and material related-party transactions. The company defended its policies, stating that total promoter pay is capped at ₹12 crore annually until FY30 and that the related-party deals are necessary to support its 87.78%-owned subsidiary.

filings.headline: Wins 150MW BESS order in Maharashtra yielding ₹42.8cr yearly revenue
filings.summary: GK Energy has received a Letter of Award for a 150 MW / 300 MWh Battery Energy Storage System in Maharashtra. The 15-year contract will generate yearly revenues of ₹42.84 crore, opening a new and significant business line for the company in the energy storage segment.

filings.headline: Conductor manufacturing capacity increased by 70% to 40,800 Km/annum
filings.summary: Transrail Lighting has completed phase 1 of its brownfield expansion at the Silvassa facility. The company's conductor manufacturing capacity has increased by 70% from 24,000 Km/annum to 40,800 Km/annum. A planned phase 2 expansion will eventually double the original capacity to meet growing market demand.

filings.headline: ₹832cr fund-raise via preferential issue of 2.65cr shares
filings.summary: OnEMI Technology is seeking shareholder approval to raise up to ₹832.2 crore via a preferential issue of 2.65 crore equity shares. The issue price of ₹314.11 is at a discount to the current market price of ₹348. The allotment will increase the total share count by 14.9%, resulting in a 13% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: Proposes Rs 85cr preferential issue to QIBs for capacity expansion
filings.summary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics is raising Rs 85 crores via a preferential issue of 16.9 lakh shares to QIBs including ICICI Prudential and Clarus Capital. The implied issue price is roughly Rs 503, slightly below the current market price, resulting in 4.9% more shares and 4.7% dilution for existing investors. The proceeds will fund working capital and expand deep freezer capacity from 1.5 lakh to 2.5 lakh units per annum.

filings.headline: Shareholders approve stock split via postal ballot
filings.summary: Shareholders have approved a resolution for the sub-division of the company's equity shares via a postal ballot. The related alterations to the capital clauses of the Memorandum and Articles of Association were also passed with the requisite majority.

filings.headline: Raises ₹600cr via first-ever QIP at ₹2,255/share
filings.summary: Neogen Chemicals has successfully raised ₹600 crore through a Qualified Institutions Placement that was oversubscribed 6.5 times. The company allotted 26.61 lakh shares at an issue price of ₹2,255 each, below the current market price of ₹2,385. This increases the total share count by 9.7%, resulting in an 8.9% dilution to existing shareholders, with proceeds allocated for debt repayment and working capital.

filings.headline: Bags ₹44.46cr, 3-year digital services contract renewal
filings.summary: Onward Technologies has secured a three-year renewal of a managed digital services contract valued at ₹44.46 crore from a major heavy equipment manufacturer. The renewed domestic order is 72% larger than the previous contract and represents about 8% of the company's yearly sales.

filings.headline: Sells subsidiary Nueclear Healthcare for ₹141.4cr
filings.summary: Thyrocare is selling its wholly owned subsidiary Nueclear Healthcare to Trovera Healthcare for roughly ₹141.4 crore, exiting the radiology business. The consideration includes ₹81.9 crore in cash and ₹59.5 crore in preference shares of the buyer. The subsidiary contributed ₹44.6 crore (5.4%) to the company's consolidated turnover last year.

filings.headline: Sells solar portfolio to Alpha Alternatives at ₹6,829cr enterprise value
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon is divesting its stake in ten under-construction solar SPVs to Alpha Alternatives at an enterprise value of ₹6,829 crore. Alpha Alternatives will fund 49% of the project's ₹1,253 crore equity during construction and acquire the remaining 51% upon completion, advancing the company's asset-light strategy and aiding deleveraging.

filings.headline: Evaluates potential MDI production complex investment in Gujarat
filings.summary: BASF is in the advanced stages of a feasibility study to construct a new MDI production complex. The company has secured an industrial land parcel in Dahej, Gujarat for the potential investment. A final decision will depend on the study's outcome and necessary regulatory approvals.

filings.headline: USFDA issues Form 483 with 5 observations for Jaggaiahpet API facility
filings.summary: The USFDA inspected the company's API manufacturing facility in Jaggaiahpet, Andhra Pradesh, from 14 to 19 September 2026. The inspection concluded with the issuance of a Form 483 containing five observations. The company will submit its response and corrective action plan within the stipulated timeline.

filings.headline: Declared L-1 bidder for ₹1,265 crore transmission project
filings.summary: Dilip Buildcon has been declared the lowest bidder by RECPDCL for a power transmission project in Maharashtra. The EPC contract is valued at ₹1,265 crore (excluding GST), which represents a significant 14.5% of the company's trailing 12-month sales. The project will be executed on a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer (BOOT) basis with a 24-month construction period.

filings.headline: Approves acquisition of DBRL's Tyre Business with ₹149.31cr turnover via demerger
filings.summary: The board has approved a scheme to acquire the Tyre Business of Dalmia Bharat Refractories Ltd via a demerger. The target business had a turnover of ₹149.31 crore in the previous financial year, representing about 3.39% of Himadri's annual sales. Himadri will issue new shares to eligible DBRL shareholders to complete the transaction.

filings.headline: Promoter pledged 15.0% of shares (₹2,301cr)
filings.summary: Promoter Melligeri Private Family Foundation (Mellwood Trustee Services Private Limited) pledged 15.0% of the company (10,05,13,070 shares worth ₹2,301cr), giving the shares to lenders as security at an average price of ₹229 versus today's price of ₹263. Their total holding remained unchanged, going from 15.0% before the pledge to 15.0% after.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.99% (₹18.9cr) at about ₹155
filings.summary: Promoter group members, including director Shobhan Mittal, Bluesky Projects, and Prime Holdings, purchased 0.99% of the company in the open market for ₹18.9cr. They paid an average price of ₹155 per share, slightly below the current ₹160, increasing their total ownership from 53.3% to 54.3%.

filings.headline: Promoter group freed 6.2% of shares from pledge
filings.summary: Promoters Janky Patel and Praham India LLP secured the release of 6,16,71,158 shares (6.2% of the company) that were previously given to lenders as security, an event valued at an estimated ₹168 crore at today's price of ₹27.2. Following this pledge release, their combined ownership stake remains unchanged, going from 7.2% before to 7.2% after.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.75% (₹5.2cr) at about ₹65.0
filings.summary: Promoter group members Karan and Tushar Agrawal bought 0.75% of the company (8,00,000 shares) for ₹5.2cr via an allotment at an average price of ₹65.0, compared to today's price of ₹128. This purchase increased their combined holding from 11.8% to 12.5%.

filings.headline: Subsidiary wins two sewer rehabilitation orders worth ₹351.24cr
filings.summary: Material subsidiary Welspun Michigan Engineers Limited has secured two sewer rehabilitation projects from the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation. The total contract value is ₹351.24 crore (about 10% of the company's yearly sales), to be executed over 24 months. The new contracts will boost the subsidiary's order book from approximately ₹2,135 crore to ₹2,432 crore.

filings.headline: Raises ₹160cr via 10.25% NCDs secured by promoter share pledge
filings.summary: Anupam Rasayan is raising ₹160 crore through 13-month non-convertible debentures issued to Aditya Birla Capital at a 10.25% coupon. The debt, to be used partly for refinancing, is notable because it is secured by a first-ranking pledge over shares held by the promoter group.

filings.headline: Bags ₹160cr contract for lifting pond and fly ash
filings.summary: Refex Industries has secured a contract from a Madhya Pradesh PSU for lifting 10 lakh metric tons of pond and fly ash. The order is valued at approximately ₹160 crore, which is about 5.6% of the company's yearly sales, and is to be executed over 18 months.

filings.headline: New semiconductor and specialty gas facility begins commercial production
filings.summary: The company has commenced commercial operations at its new semiconductor and specialty gas debulking and blending facility in Khalapur, Maharashtra. The facility has an installed capacity of 1,200 MT per annum and marks the company's entry into the semiconductor and specialty gases segment. This new capacity is expected to be a key contributor to revenue growth.

filings.headline: Subsidiary signs major supply agreement for up to 1 GWh of battery cells
filings.summary: Advait's step-down subsidiary has entered into a Master Supply Agreement with Hithium to purchase LFP prismatic battery cells for its upcoming 2.5 GWh BESS assembly facility. The initial contractual value is $49.5/kWh for up to 350 MWh (roughly $17.3 million or ₹143 crore), with the arrangement structured to support cell offtake of up to 1 GWh over the next year.

filings.headline: CRISIL revises rating outlook to Negative for ₹150cr bank facilities
filings.summary: CRISIL Ratings has reaffirmed the long-term rating on the company's ₹150.31 crore bank facilities at CRISIL A, but revised the outlook from 'Stable' to 'Negative'. The short-term rating was reaffirmed at CRISIL A1.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgraded ratings to AA-/Stable and A1+ for ₹953cr facilities
filings.summary: CRISIL has upgraded the company's long-term bank facility rating to AA-/Stable from A+/Stable and its short-term rating to A1+ from A1. The rated bank loan facilities have also been enhanced to ₹953 crore from ₹761 crore.

filings.headline: Infomerics upgrades long-term credit rating to IVR A/Stable
filings.summary: Infomerics Valuation and Rating Private Limited has upgraded the credit rating on the company's ₹103.7 crore bank facilities to IVR A/Stable for long-term and IVR A1 for short-term. The upgrade reflects an improvement in the financial risk profile, deleveraging, and reduced financial exposure to its wholly owned subsidiary.

filings.headline: Promoter group sold 0.24% (₹15.5cr) at about ₹441
filings.summary: Promoter group member Dinesh Sharma sold 3,50,450 shares (0.24% of the company) in a market sale worth ₹15.5cr. He sold at an average price of ₹441, which is higher than today's price of ₹414, reducing his holding from 3.7% to 3.5%.

filings.headline: Promoter sold 0.06% (₹14.1cr at today's price)
filings.summary: Promoter Leelavathi Parvatha Reddy sold 20,000 shares (0.06% of the company) on the open market, worth an estimated ₹14.1 crore at today's price of ₹7,050. Following this sale, her holding decreased from 4.3% to 4.2%.

filings.headline: Promoter sold 3.9% (₹175cr) at about ₹390
filings.summary: Promoter Vidhi S Khandelwal sold 3.9% of the company (44,87,203 shares) in a market sale for ₹175cr. The shares were sold at an average price of ₹390, compared to today's price of ₹671, reducing her holding from 15.7% to 11.8%.

filings.headline: Independent Director Raghu Ram Hiremagalur Venkatesh resigns
filings.summary: Raghu Ram Hiremagalur Venkatesh has resigned as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the company with immediate effect. He cited pre-occupation with other professional commitments and confirmed there are no other material reasons for his early departure.

filings.headline: Board to consider demerger of DBRL's Tyre Business into Himadri
filings.summary: The Board of Directors will meet on September 21, 2026, to consider and approve a proposed Scheme of Arrangement. The scheme involves the demerger of the Tyre Business from Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited (DBRL) into Himadri Speciality.

filings.headline: Acquires 76% stake in Mazzini Tiles LLP for ₹40.42cr
filings.summary: Apollo Pipes has entered the ceramic tiles sector by acquiring a 76% stake in Mazzini Tiles LLP for ₹40.42 crore. Mazzini operates a manufacturing facility in Morbi, Gujarat, and reported a turnover of ₹87.15 crore for FY26. The transaction is part of the company's approved ₹300 crore investment plan to expand its presence in the building materials segment.

filings.headline: India Ratings upgraded long-term rating to IND AA-/Stable
filings.summary: India Ratings and Research has upgraded the company's long-term bank facilities rating to IND AA-/Stable from IND A+/Positive. The short-term rating was affirmed at IND A1+. The upgrade reflects the company's strong operating performance, healthy profitability, and an improved financial profile following an equity raise.

filings.headline: Won dispute adjudication awards totaling ₹40.27cr
filings.summary: Solarworld Energy Solutions has won two Dispute Adjudication Board awards against SJVN Green Energy regarding EPC contracts for solar projects in Gujarat. The company was awarded a total of ₹40.27 crore, comprising ₹7.88 crore in cash and ₹32.39 crore in retention-money releases. The company had originally claimed about ₹219.3 crore.

filings.headline: Subsidiary won a ₹217.56cr order from Indus Towers for battery banks
filings.summary: Replus Engitech Private Limited, a subsidiary of the company, has received an order worth ₹217.56 crore from Indus Towers Limited for the supply of lithium-ion battery banks. The contract is to be executed by March 2027 and represents about 8% of the company's annual sales.

filings.headline: Appointed date set for ₹4,263cr Agra-Gwalior highway project
filings.summary: NHAI has declared September 7 as the appointed date for the Agra-Gwalior greenfield highway project. The estimated project cost is ₹4,263 crore, equivalent to about 46% of the company's yearly sales. The DBFOT toll project has a completion period of 910 days from the appointed date.

filings.headline: Alters MoA to add medical, space and energy to business objects
filings.summary: Avantel's board has approved altering its Memorandum of Association to add medical devices, space and satellite technology, energy systems, and electronics manufacturing to its main business objects. The board also approved the merger of wholly owned subsidiary Imeds Global into the company.

filings.headline: Income Tax department appeals to ITAT over ₹56.2 crore tax demand
filings.summary: The Income Tax Department has filed an appeal with the ITAT against an earlier order that deleted a ₹56.21 crore tax demand for AY 2022-23. The original demand, which relates to the disallowance of exemptions on agricultural income, represents about 4.4% of the company's yearly sales.

filings.headline: Completed sale of subsidiary KNR Guruvayur Infra for ₹485.86cr
filings.summary: KNR Constructions has transferred its entire equity share capital in its wholly owned subsidiary KNR Guruvayur Infra Private Limited to Indus Infra Trust. The company received a consideration of ₹485.86 crore against its original investment of ₹193.32 crore. The SPV contributed ₹237.21 crore (8.8%) to the consolidated turnover in the last financial year.

filings.headline: Preferential issue to SBI Mutual Fund raises ₹300cr
filings.summary: Rossell Techsys is raising ₹300 crore through a preferential issue of 25.72 lakh equity shares to SBI Mutual Fund and SBI Optimal Equity Fund. The shares will be issued at ₹1,166 each, which is a discount to the current market price of about ₹1,368. This issuance will increase the company's share count by about 6.8%, resulting in a 6.4% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: Gujarat plant fully resumes operations after flood disruption
filings.summary: Remsons Industries has fully restored and resumed operations at its manufacturing facility in Pardi, Gujarat. The plant had suffered a temporary disruption for nearly two months since July 23 due to severe flooding and waterlogging.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.25% (₹9.1cr) at about ₹418
filings.summary: Promoter group Nirani Holdings Private Limited bought 2,18,275 shares (0.25% of the company) for ₹9.1 crore in the open market. They paid an average price of ₹418—below today's price of ₹451—increasing their total holding from 1.7% to 1.9%.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹832cr preferential issue at ₹314.11 per share
filings.summary: OnEMI Technology's board has approved raising ₹832.2 crore through a preferential issue of 2.65 crore equity shares to 34 non-promoter investors. The issue price of ₹314.11 is below the current market price of about ₹342. This issuance will create roughly 14.9% more shares, resulting in a 13% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: NTPC invokes bank guarantees and surety bonds worth ₹90.86 crore
filings.summary: NTPC has invoked a mobilization advance bank guarantee of ₹49.53 crore and three performance surety bonds totaling ₹41.34 crore against the company. This action follows a termination notice issued by GR Infraprojects for the underlying contracts just two days earlier. The company is exploring its legal and contractual remedies regarding the ₹90.86 crore encashment.

filings.headline: Starts production at new ₹24cr Bhilad packaging plant
filings.summary: Time Technoplast has completed its greenfield packaging plant at Bhilad, Gujarat, for manufacturing conical polymer pails and injection-moulded products. The fully automated facility has an annual capacity of 6,000 tonnes and was set up with an investment of ₹24 crore. At 90% utilization, the plant is expected to generate approximately ₹100 crore in annual turnover, representing about 1.5% of the company's yearly sales.

filings.headline: GPT Infraprojects bags ₹484cr railway bridge contract from RVNL
filings.summary: GPT Infraprojects has secured an order worth ₹483.72 crore (including GST) from Rail Vikas Nigam Limited for the construction of a steel girder bridge over the Mahanadi river. The contract, to be executed over 1,095 days, is highly material at about 38% of the company's yearly sales. The company's outstanding order book now stands at ₹4,992 crore.

filings.headline: CARE upgrades credit rating on bank facilities to BBB+ (Stable)
filings.summary: CARE Ratings has upgraded the credit rating for the company's long-term bank facilities (₹433.13 crore total) to CARE BBB+; Stable from CARE BBB; Positive. The upgrade factors in the divestment of loss-making overseas subsidiaries and a growing order book in the higher-margin Build to Specification (BTS) segment.

filings.headline: Board approves ₹3,150cr fund-raise via shares and warrants to Cyprus investor
filings.summary: The board has approved a preferential issue of 1.30 crore shares and 1.89 crore warrants to Cyprus-based Rasmalai Limited for ₹3,150 crore. The issue price of ₹985.17 is at an 11.5% discount to the current share price. This massive fund-raise will increase the total share count by about 33%, resulting in a roughly 25% dilution for existing shareholders and making the new investor a significant stakeholder.

filings.headline: Secures ₹2,600cr redevelopment project in Goregaon West, Mumbai
filings.summary: Puravankara has secured redevelopment rights for three residential societies in Goregaon West, Mumbai, spread across 4.68 acres. The project offers an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of ₹2,600 crore, which is approximately 64% of the company's yearly sales, and 1.05 million sq. ft. of developable potential.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgraded ratings on ₹940cr bank facilities to AA-/Stable
filings.summary: CRISIL has upgraded SG Mart's long-term bank facilities (totaling ₹940 crore) to CRISIL AA-/Stable from CRISIL A. The short-term rating was also upgraded to CRISIL A1+ from CRISIL A1, with both ratings removed from 'Rating Watch with Positive Implications'.

filings.headline: Promoter group sold 0.53% (₹25.8cr) at about ₹505
filings.summary: Promoter Harshbeena Zaveri and the Trilochan Singh Sahney Trust 1 sold 5,10,000 shares (0.53% of the company) for ₹25.8cr in a market sale. The shares were sold at an average price of ₹505—below the current price of ₹549—reducing their holding from 42.0% to 41.5%.

filings.headline: Promoter sold 0.39% (₹13.0cr) at about ₹1,580
filings.summary: Promoter and Director Savita Vashist sold 82,313 shares (0.39% of the company) for ₹13.0cr at an average price of ₹1,580, which is below the current price of ₹1,707. This market sale decreased her total holding from 24.1% to 23.7%.

filings.headline: Preferential issue of 22.27 lakh shares to raise ₹372cr at ₹1,670/share
filings.summary: Venus Pipes & Tubes has scheduled an EGM to approve a preferential issue of 22.27 lakh equity shares to raise ₹372 crore from various funds and investors. The issue price of ₹1,670 per share is below the current market price of around ₹2,154. The new shares represent a 10.8% increase in the share count, resulting in a 9.7% dilution for existing shareholders.

filings.headline: India Ratings upgraded long-term credit rating to IND AA/Stable
filings.summary: India Ratings and Research has upgraded the company's long-term bank facilities rating (₹1,304 crore) to IND AA/Stable from IND AA-/Stable. The agency also assigned an IND AA/Stable/IND A1+ rating to an additional ₹3,000 crore in bank facilities.

filings.headline: CRISIL upgrades long-term credit rating to AA-/Stable
filings.summary: CRISIL Ratings has upgraded its credit ratings on the ₹280 crore bank facilities of Apollo Pipes. The long-term rating is upgraded to CRISIL AA-/Stable from CRISIL A, and the short-term rating is upgraded to CRISIL A1+ from CRISIL A1. The ratings were removed from 'Rating Watch with Positive Implications'.

filings.headline: USFDA issues EIR and closes inspection at Vadodara facility
filings.summary: The USFDA has issued an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) for the company's Bioequivalence Facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. This marks the successful closure of the regulatory inspection conducted between March 3 and March 7, 2025.

filings.headline: Completes installation of SiC Epitaxial Wafer reactors at Odisha facility
filings.summary: The company has completed the erection and installation of Silicon Carbide (SiC) Epitaxial Wafer Manufacturing Reactors at its Bhubaneswar, Odisha facility. This forms a major part of the company's planned ₹618 crore investment to establish India's first vertically integrated SiC semiconductor production ecosystem. Commercial production is expected to commence upon completion of remaining regulatory formalities.

filings.headline: Sanjeev Kumar appointed as Managing Director, replacing Rajkumar Beniwal
filings.summary: The Government of Gujarat has nominated Shri Sanjeev Kumar, IAS as the new Managing Director of the company, effective September 9, 2026. He takes over the charge following the relinquishment of the role by former MD Shri Rajkumar Beniwal.

filings.headline: Material Swedish subsidiary LMG to launch IPO, selling up to 30.2% stake
filings.summary: Kalpataru Projects' material Swedish subsidiary, Linjemontage i Grästorp AB (LMG), will launch an initial public offering on Nasdaq Stockholm. The offering includes a sale of up to 15.47 million shares (up to a 30.19% stake) by Kalpataru's wholly-owned subsidiary at SEK 46 per share, valuing LMG at approximately ₹2,324 crore. LMG contributed 11.14% to the company's consolidated revenue last financial year.

filings.headline: Wins 15-year PPP contract in Punjab, entering PET-CT diagnostic segment
filings.summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics has executed a 15-year concession agreement with the Punjab government to develop and operate PET-CT facilities at four government hospitals. The contract marks the company's entry into the specialized PET-CT diagnostic segment. Built on a Public Private Partnership (PPP) model, revenues will depend on the actual number of scans rather than a fixed upfront consideration.

filings.headline: Commenced operations at new 50-bed hospital in Guntur
filings.summary: Rainbow Children's Medicare has commenced operations at a new 50-bed women's and children's hospital in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh. This new facility expands the company's regional footprint and operating capacity.

filings.headline: Care Ratings upgrades bank facilities to BBB+ and A3+
filings.summary: Care Ratings has upgraded Ceinsys Tech's long-term bank facilities (₹80 crore) to CARE BBB+ with a Stable outlook, from CARE BBB with a Positive outlook. The short-term bank facilities (₹80 crore) were also upgraded to CARE A3+ from CARE A3. The agency cited the company's improved scale of operations and profitability as key drivers for the upgrade.

filings.headline: Shareholders reject proposed preferential issue of 11 crore warrants
filings.summary: Shareholders at the company's EGM have voted against management proposals to increase the authorized share capital and issue 11 crore convertible warrants on a preferential basis. The failed warrant issue would have created 28.8% more shares (a 22.3% dilution for existing investors). Public institutional and non-institutional shareholders voted heavily against the resolutions.

filings.headline: Juniper Hotels to acquire Novotel Imagicaa for ₹248cr
filings.summary: Juniper Hotels has approved the acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa, an operating 287-room hotel in Khopoli, Maharashtra, from Imagicaaworld Entertainment for a cash consideration of ₹248 crore. The purchase price is equivalent to about 23% of the company's annual sales, with the deal expected to close by March 2027.

filings.headline: Secures ₹1,041cr order from SECI for 600 MWp solar PV modules
filings.summary: Saatvik Green Energy has won an order worth ₹1,041.63 crore from the Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) for the supply of domestically manufactured solar PV modules. The 600 MWp capacity order is to be executed by December 2027 and is highly material, representing about 25% of the company's annual sales.

filings.headline: Praj signs exclusive agreement with Gevo for Bio-IBA commercialization in India
filings.summary: Praj Industries and Gevo Inc. have signed a Development and Commercialization Agreement, granting Praj exclusive rights to deploy Bio-Isobutanol (Bio-IBA) technology in India. To advance this technology for diesel blending, Praj is currently establishing India's first commercial Bio-IBA demonstration plant for a leading Oil Marketing Company.

filings.headline: NPCI introduces up to 0.4% MDR on UPI P2M transactions over ₹2,000
filings.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has introduced a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) of up to 0.4% on UPI Person-to-Merchant transactions exceeding ₹2,000, effective October 15, 2026. This will allow MobiKwik to generate new revenue on previously free transactions, both as a Third-Party Application Provider and an acquirer. The company views this as a strong enabler to scale its merchant business.

filings.headline: Promoter group bought 0.31% (₹2.9cr) at about ₹580
filings.summary: Promoter Basant Kumar Kabra bought 50,000 shares (0.31% of the company) on the open market for ₹2.9 crore. The shares were acquired at an average price of ₹580—slightly below the current price of ₹595—increasing his total holding from 18.2% to 18.5%.

filings.headline: High Court upholds DRDO tender award to Apollo Micro Systems
filings.summary: Apollo Micro Systems clarified that the Andhra Pradesh High Court has rejected a competitor's petition challenging a DRDO/NSTL contract awarded to the company. The tender award for PBMM-NG technology remains valid and in favour of the company, subject only to routine pre-award verification, clearing a legal hurdle.

filings.headline: Signed ₹1,250cr agreement with Avaada Electro for 1GW solar cells
filings.summary: Vikram Solar has signed a domestic supply agreement with Avaada Electro to procure 1 GW of ALMM-compliant TOPCon solar cells. The contract is valued at approximately ₹1,250 crore, representing about 24% of the company's yearly sales. Deliveries will commence in September 2026 to support its Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) module manufacturing operations.

filings.headline: Forms 50:50 JV with BHEL for 35-year Vande Bharat maintenance contract
filings.summary: Titagarh Rail Systems and BHEL have executed a 50:50 Joint Venture Agreement to maintain 80 Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets for a period of 35 years. This agreement forms part of a massive ₹24,000 crore contract awarded by Indian Railways to the TRSL-BHEL consortium for the manufacture and maintenance of the trains, providing immense long-term revenue visibility.

filings.headline: CFO Rahul Murarka resigns
filings.summary: Chief Financial Officer Rahul Murarka has resigned to pursue the next phase of his professional journey. He will be relieved from his duties at the close of business on November 14, 2026.

filings.headline: Allotted 92 lakh shares in ₹106cr rights issue at ₹115 each
filings.summary: Viceroy Hotels allotted 92.03 lakh equity shares on a rights basis at an issue price of ₹115 per share, slightly below the current market price of ₹127. The ₹105.8 crore issue expands the company's paid-up share capital by 13.6%, causing a 12% dilution for shareholders who did not participate.

filings.headline: NHAI debars company from bidding for three years
filings.summary: NHAI has extended a three-year debarment to PNC Infratech, preventing it from participating in any bids by MoRTH, NHAI, and their executing agencies. The action stems from its role as promoter of a debarred concessionaire, Awadh Expressway Private Limited. The company says ongoing projects are unaffected and is evaluating legal remedies.

filings.headline: US FDA issues Form-483 with 7 observations for Morpeth, UK facility
filings.summary: The US FDA inspected Piramal Pharma's Morpeth, UK facility from September 3 to 11 and issued a Form-483 with seven observations. The company stated the observations relate to practices, procedures, and documentation, and it is preparing a detailed response within the stipulated timeline.

filings.headline: Income tax demands totaling ₹59.74cr for company and subsidiaries
filings.summary: The Income Tax Department has issued final assessment orders demanding a total of ₹59.74 crore, including interest, from Yatharth Hospital and its subsidiaries AKS and Ramraja. The total demand equals roughly 4.5% of the company's yearly sales. The company plans to appeal the orders and expects substantial relief, so it has not made any financial provision at this time.

filings.headline: Secured new orders worth ₹1,303cr across T&D and Cables businesses
filings.summary: KEC International has secured new orders worth ₹1,303 crores across its Transmission & Distribution and Cables businesses in India, the Middle East, and the Americas. The order win represents about 5.5% of the company's trailing 12-month sales, taking its year-to-date order intake to over ₹7,600 crores.

filings.headline: Promoter group sold 1.0% (₹15.5cr) at about ₹185
filings.summary: Promoter group member Jitendra Uttamchand Mehta sold 8,37,240 shares (1.0% of the company) for ₹15.5cr in a market sale at an average price of ₹185, just below the current price of ₹186. This transaction reduced his holding from 1.3% to 0.22%.

filings.headline: Clean US FDA inspection at Switzerland site with zero observations
filings.summary: The company's wholly owned subsidiary, Carbogen Amcis AG, successfully completed its first US FDA inspection at its manufacturing site in Vionnaz, Switzerland. The inspection concluded with zero observations and no Form 483 was issued.

filings.headline: Board submits two candidates for MD & CEO role to RBI, adds Executive Directors
filings.summary: HDFC Bank's board has approved submitting the names of two candidates to the RBI for the role of Managing Director and CEO for a three-year term. The board also appointed Jimmy Tata as a Whole-time Director for three years, re-appointed V. Srinivasa Rangan for a one-year term, and created a fourth Whole-time Director position to strengthen succession planning and oversight.

filings.headline: Shareholders reject appointment of Shanay Vikram Shah as Whole-time Director
filings.summary: Shareholders of Shalby Limited have rejected the ordinary resolutions to appoint Mr. Shanay Vikram Shah as Director and Whole-time Director at the AGM on September 10, 2026.
